name: cinemora-web-engine
description: Cinemora Animation Studio web render engine: headless-Chromium scenes (Three.js globe, GSAP kinetic type, Lottie route) rendered frame-by-frame for the motion graphics pipeline. Install with: npm install (Puppeteer downloads its Chromium). Point CINEMORA_WEB_ENGINE_HOME at the install directory when it is not this folder.
